newsitem.title: USA: NCR, Unisys in item processing pact.
newsitem.headline: NCR, Unisys in item processing pact.

text.p: NCR Corp and Unisys Corp said Monday that they agreed to exchange image and item processing technologies that they offer to global financial institutions.
The original equipment manufacturing (OEM) agreement will allow each company to sell certain products manufactured by the other company, they said in a joint statement.
The companies said the pact involves the exchange of two products: the NCR single pocket proof encoder and the Unisys high-speed Windows NT-based transports.

"Unisys and NCR have joined forces in a groundbreaking technology exchange," said Michael Thomas, vice president of Unisysy payment systems programs. "This alliance is expected to result in expanded market share for both companies."
No further details of the pact were available.
